vendor/glyph.js bundles loadFont and run from Ivar Vong's glyph (https://github.com/ivarvong/glyph),
built by tools/vendor-glyph.ts. It came into this repository with Lantern at 2c7bad5. Its WOFF2
decoder embeds Brotli's static dictionary (RFC 7932); glyph carries no separate notice for it.
